$comment: BASELINE-001 — UNIVERSAL CONSTITUTIONAL BASELINE INHERITANCE (declaration). This file is
DATA and is the ONLY place this measurement's capability set, register pointers, scheme
source, succession reader, inheritance rules, non-inheritance rules, currency claims,
citation surfaces, version sources, lineage source, validation dimensions and exit criteria
are stated. baseline_engine.py contains no baseline identifier, no commit identity, no
ordinal, no state token and no release identifier: everything it registers, resolves,
validates and reports is READ from here and from the LOCATED records named here.
KNOWLEDGE ONCE — WHY NO BASELINE IS DEFINED IN THIS FILE. The repository already records its
certified baselines. BASELINE-REGISTRY.md is the canonical, append-only register of them and
is the located owner of the record; RELEASE-001 §3.1 owns the naming scheme and §3.3 the
advancement criteria; EVOLUTION-001 §6 owns the evolution version history. This declaration
RESTATES none of them. It declares WHERE they live and HOW to read them, and DISCOVERS the
baselines, their ordinals, their commits, their states, their predecessors, their records and
the advancement criteria at run time. A baseline appended to the located register is therefore
discovered here automatically; a baseline referenced anywhere but recorded nowhere is
surfaced as an UNRECORDED BASELINE rather than silently accepted.
WHAT THIS ADDS, AND WHY IT IS NOT A PARALLEL AUTHORITY. It creates no baseline, certifies no
baseline, advances no baseline, ratifies nothing, freezes nothing and occupies no tier. Its
authority is NONE — DERIVED TRUTH. No second baseline programme, register, namespace,
identifier family or lifecycle is created: CMG-INV-02 requires the concern-to-owner map be
injective and BASELINE-001 already owns certified baseline, so this measurement is held BY
that owner, inside that owner's home. What no located programme owned is the MEASUREMENT of
the baseline chain: before this, the chain existed only as prose, so no gate could resolve a
baseline, detect a missing or duplicated row, detect a break in succession, detect a second
claimed current baseline, detect a citation of a baseline that was never recorded, or detect
that a register citing a baseline had gone stale against the register that records it.
WHAT THIS DELIBERATELY DOES NOT DO. It does not advance a baseline: advancement is measured
against the located criteria and reported, never conferred. It does not edit a record: the
register is append-only and --check-record-immutability proves mechanically that this
measurement's write set is disjoint from the located record set. It does not decide a
divergence between the baseline register and another register that cites a baseline: where a
located currency claim and the located register disagree, both are MEASURED, both are CITED,
and a DIVERGES-REFERRED outcome is reported for the claim owner to dispose of under CEP-002
Article 23. It never converts a measured divergence into an advancement, a certification, a
ratification or an elevation.

programme.name: Universal Constitutional Baseline Inheritance
programme.authority: NONE — DERIVED TRUTH. This measurement creates no baseline, advances no baseline, certifies nothing, ratifies nothing, freezes nothing and occupies no tier. It reads the located records that already register the repository's certified baselines and reports what they say.
programme.disclosure: **DISCLOSURE.** CERTIFIED-PROVISIONAL; Tier T1 VACANT. This measurement holds no certification authority, no ratification authority and no freeze authority: it registers, resolves, validates and reports the baselines the repository has already recorded. Where this measurement and a located record differ, the located record governs.

discharges it. A capability whose measure does not run is reported UNDISCHARGED and fails
closed: absence of a measurement is never evidence of a capability.

every registered baseline resolves to a located evidence block, whether that block is a record file or a section of the register itself
every registered baseline identifier conforms to the naming scheme its located owner declares
the register is dense and monotone in the ordinal of the scheme, so every baseline is addressable and no row is missing, duplicated or out of order
the constitutional lineage population is measured, every recorded predecessor resolves, and the declared inheritance relationship type is located rather than assumed
every non-origin baseline records an EXPLICIT predecessor that is itself a registered baseline, and the chain is acyclic with exactly one origin and exactly one head
every inheritance rule the corpus legislates binds to a located clause whose text is verified present
every constitutional artifact whose recorded version exceeds the base version has a version-increment event in the located change ledger whose target equals the recorded version
every evolution release the current baseline claims in its chain is recorded in the located evolution register
exactly one baseline carries the located current token, it is the head of the chain, and every located claim of currency is measured against it and reported without being decided
the located ratification ceiling is bound and every registered baseline discloses it; no baseline is recorded ratified beyond that ceiling
every registered baseline records a certification state drawn from the located state vocabulary, and the state is read rather than conferred
the register and this measurement each disclose that they hold no authority, and no authority is inherited by a baseline from its predecessor
every repository pointer in every baseline record resolves, so no baseline rests on evidence that has since gone
every machine model the current baseline was measured from resolves, so the derivation of the baseline remains re-readable
the constitutional versions the current baseline records are read from the located constitutional register rather than restated
every declared scope rule binds to a located clause, so the bounds of a baseline are read from the instruments that set them
every advancement criterion the located scheme owner declares is discovered and corroborated in the current baseline's evidence block

no baseline is elevated: no registered baseline records the terminal finality token, and this measurement confers no state on any baseline

$register_comment: The located baseline register. Rows are DISCOVERED: the identifier column, the commit column,
the state column and the record column are read, never declared. id_column is the column
index of the identifier, which is not column zero because the register's first column is the
row ordinal — declaring the index is what keeps the reader free of a positional assumption.
current_token is the exact token the register uses to mark the current baseline; it is
matched on the upper-cased state cell so that a row which merely mentions being superseded
as current is not mistaken for the current row.

$succession_comment: Succession. CMG-000001 XXXIX.6 requires inheritance to be EXPLICIT and prohibits implicit
inheritance from a containing programme, phase or directory. Row order alone is therefore
insufficient: a non-origin baseline must RECORD its predecessor. The claim is read from the
baseline's own evidence block, which is its record file where the record cell resolves to a
path, and otherwise the section of the register whose heading names the baseline. Both the
explicit claim and the structural order are measured, and a disagreement between them is a
failure rather than a resolution in favour of either.

succession_source.basis: 00-CMG/CMG-000001 ARTICLE XXXIX.6 — inheritance SHALL be explicit and implicit inheritance IS PROHIBITED; ARTICLE XXVIII.4 — a superseded version SHALL be reachable from its successor by an explicit lineage link.

increment was recorded. Three located registers are read against each other: the

artifact above the base version whose increment is unrecorded is a break in version
succession, which is inheritance in its most concrete form.

$record_comment: The canonical record set. These are the append-only records this measurement may never write.

$findings_comment: Findings this measurement discloses rather than resolves.

findings.title: The baseline chain was prose, so no gate could resolve a baseline
findings.note: BASELINE-001 was the only located programme in the operational-memory zone with no declaration, no engine and no gate: its register, its origin record, its certificate and its continuation classification were four markdown files. Consequently no gate could resolve which baseline was current, none could detect a missing, duplicated or out-of-order row, none could detect a break in succession, none could detect a baseline cited but never recorded, and none could detect that a recorded baseline had come to rest on evidence that no longer existed. Closed by DERIVING the chain from the located records rather than by authoring a second baseline register.

findings.title: Located registers cite a baseline that the baseline register no longer records as current; the divergence is referred, not decided
findings.note: The baseline register records the current certified baseline. The release lifecycle's header, its version history and the evolution governance model's header each still name the baseline that preceded it. Both sides are Repository Truth: the register records currency, and the release lifecycle owns the scheme and the version history. Deciding between them is reserved to the claim owner under CEP-002 Article 23.2; this measurement reads both, cites both, and refers. It does not edit either claimant — both are named in programme.forbidden_write_prefixes precisely so that it cannot.

findings.title: The constitutional lineage invariant is satisfied vacuously, and the inheritance relationship type has no instances
findings.note: The located meta-constitutional projection carries a lineage-predecessor field on every registered artifact and declares an inheritance relationship type, and the located validator verifies that every recorded predecessor resolves. No artifact records a predecessor and no artifact declares an inheritance edge, so the invariant cannot currently fail and a vacuously satisfied invariant is indistinguishable from an enforced one. This measurement reports the population so the vacuity is visible. It does not populate the field: what an artifact inherits from is its own declaration to make under CMG-000001 XXXIX.6, and the field belongs to the meta-constitutional register, not to the baseline owner.

findings.title: A recorded baseline's measured values are historical; only its pointers are required to remain resolvable
findings.note: A baseline is a snapshot: the values it records were measured at the commit it names, and the register is append-only, so requiring a recorded value to still match a live re-measurement would require editing the record and would destroy the very immutability the baseline exists to provide. What this measurement therefore requires of a historical record is that its POINTERS still resolve — that the evidence a baseline was derived from is still present and re-readable — and not that its values still agree. A recorded fixed-point verdict measured against an earlier pipeline declaration remains a true statement about that declaration at that commit.

findings.title: A tag exists in the baseline tag namespace under a convention the located scheme does not declare
findings.note: The located release lifecycle declares an ordinal baseline scheme and an operational convention of tagging a baseline with it. A version-control tag exists in that namespace formed from an abbreviated commit identity rather than an ordinal, and it is therefore not a citation of the ordinal family and not a recorded baseline. This measurement does not read version control: the containing commit and the tag namespace are owned by version control and are deliberately not restated in a record. The observation is disclosed here for the scheme owner. Nothing in this measurement depends on it.
